prompt: A HorizontalPodAutoscaler isn't scaling up our `api` deployment even though CPU metrics show 95% sustained. Diagnostic plan?
promptVariations: HPA is stuck; `api` pods are hammered at 95% CPU but no new replicas. Walk through diagnosis.

rubric: Verifies metrics-server is running and reporting
Checks CPU resource REQUESTS are set (HPA uses request %, not absolute)
Inspects HPA events and status conditions
Does NOT recommend manually kubectl scale as a fix (that masks the issue)
